name: After § 32
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 32a. Is committed to significantly increasing financial assistance to the Palestinian people in order to promote peace and reconciliation in the Middle East; expects, at the same time, the removal of antisemitic content from Palestinian schoolbooks and the discontinuation of Palestinian benefit schemes that provide financial allowances to individuals or their families for involvement in acts of terrorism;
